identification: Carlton Ware (Stoke-on-Trent) lobster and lettuce salad ware: footed lobster salad bowl with lobster claw servers, green leaf oval plate with painted lobsters (marked Registered Australian Design), yellow leaf dish with tomatoes and lettuce spoon with lobster claw handle.
